notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Main features:

 Bots now have abilities (PushRay, JumpCancel, ShoeThrow, CurveBall, Platformer)
 Improved bot ai.
 Added selection for random color and random ability.
 Platformer now can bounce the PushRay ability.
 Added new stats (ServeAce and AbilityUse counters)
 Updated win screen stat design.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed various bot related bugs.
 Fixed various animation related bugs.
